verticals.name: GovTech / Public Sector AI
verticals.tagline: OMB M-24-10 + AI Bill of Rights + Section 508 + Privacy Act + FOIA + NIST AI RMF + EO 14110 (rescinded) / EO 14179 + FedRAMP + state government AI laws.
verticals.lede: Six sibling specs for AI tools used BY government — federal agency benefit determinations, federal contracting recommendations, FOIA processing, IRS / SSA / VA / DHS / state-Medicaid decision support, public-services chatbots, regulatory permitting. Distinct from the prior 6 verticals (which cover regulators telling the private sector what to do): GovTech covers government's OWN AI use rules. The Suite vertical 6-pack a federal agency's Chief AI Officer + Office of Civil Rights + OIG + General Counsel need to publish OMB M-24-10 §3(a) Federal AI Use Case Inventory entries + rights-impacting + safety-impacting AI impact assessments.
